name: Samanvayam Khel Utsav
eligibility:
1. Open to Samanvayam members and their families.
2. Each Samanvayam member registers on behalf of their family (wife or husband, daughters, sons and other family members) from one account, under the member's Qatar ID. Family members do not need separate accounts.
3. Registration of new Samanvayam members is subject to approval by the Sports Coordinator and the Samanvayam ExCom.
4. Age is counted on the day of the tournament: Kids U10 7 to 10 years, Kids 10 to 14 years, Youth over 14 up to 18 years, Adults 18 years and above.
5. Singles categories are by gender, except Kids U10 which is open to all. Doubles - Men's Open (18+) is for men, and Doubles - Women is for women. Doubles - Mixed Open needs one man and one woman, and Doubles - Spouse is for husband and wife. Kids and youth cannot enter Doubles - Spouse, Doubles - Women or Doubles - Mixed Open (adults).
6. For doubles, the registering player enters their partner's name. The partner does not need to register separately.
7. A player may enter more than one category, as long as the schedule allows.
rules:
1. Participation fee, Singles: Kids, Youth and Female QAR 30 per individual. Male QAR 35 per individual.
2. Participation fee, Doubles: all doubles categories QAR 60 per pair (QAR 30 + QAR 30).
3. Plastic shuttlecocks will be used throughout the tournament.
4. Match format: all matches, including semifinals and finals, are best of three games.
5. Badminton day is 30 October and the finals are on 6 November. Registration closes on 25 October.
6. The match schedule, fixtures, playing conditions and any other tournament rules will be communicated to registered participants later.
7. Age and identity may be checked against the Qatar ID given at registration. Wrong information can lead to disqualification.
8. Game Coordinator: Sanjay Vaidya, +974 6642 2213. For more information contact the Khel Utsav Coordinator, Mohit Katiyar, on 3325 4295, or any Samanvayam ExCom member.
